targets.concept: average annual wage per full-time-equivalent dependent employee
targets.referencePeriod: dataset supports annual observations; exact calibration year not yet selected
targets.nominalReal: multiple published forms; calibration convention unresolved
targets.mapping: requires conversion to monthly model wage and a decision on gross wage versus broader compensation concept
targets.limitations: average wage is not median wage, disposable income, or household income

targets.concept: value-added labor productivity per hour worked or per employed person
targets.nominalReal: international comparisons commonly use real/PPP output
targets.timeBasis: per hour or per employed person
targets.mapping: requires value-added-to-model-gross-output bridge and worker-hour-to-worker-month bridge
targets.limitations: aggregate labor productivity is not identical to physical product units per model worker

targets.concept: households and NPISHs final consumption expenditure
targets.sourceDataset: World Development Indicators / ICP national accounts
targets.referencePeriod: annual series; exact calibration year not yet selected
targets.mapping: requires realized-final-expenditure versus desired-budget bridge and model-consumption-coverage adjustment
targets.limitations: national accounts include categories and imputed expenditures that may not exist in the model

targets.mapping: requires classification bridge from empirical industries/products to RESOURCE, MATERIALS, CAPITAL, CONSUMER
targets.limitations: R4-CS proves sector dispersion but does not provide empirical target ratios

targets.concept: firm liquidity buffer, working-capital need, and trade-credit capacity
targets.mapping: requires external firm-finance evidence; simulation arrears and exits are not empirical anchors
targets.limitations: must distinguish cash buffer, receivables/payables, credit line capacity, and payroll coverage
